items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It's Andrew Kimball. I was going to say Andrew Kimball was supposed to be the trumpet player with... [INTERVIEWEE] I think, this is not Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: Most of the time the trumpet player was the leader of the band, but I really don't remember. But I know some of the fellas on there, I think he has the name of them, the guys who, the name of the fellas.

We were wondering once who the trumpet player was, and I wonder if somebody thought it might be Manuel Perez, but... It's Andrew Kimball. I was going to say Andrew Kimball was supposed to be the trumpet player with...
I think, this is not Manuel Perez.
